newsitem.title: USA: Thermadyne to sell unit for $102.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Thermadyne to sell unit for $102.5 mln.

text.p: Thermadyne Holdings Corp said it reached a definitive agreement to sell its wear resistance business, Deloro Satellite Holdings Corp, in a management buyout for $102.5 million.
The purchase price is comprised of $95 million in cash plus $7.5 million in assumed long-term liabilities.
Closing of the transaction is subject to customary conditions and is expected to occur in the third quarter, said Thermadyne, a maker of cutting welding products.
The wear resistance business sells wear resistant components and hardfacing materials. It had pro forma sales in 1996 of $109 million.
"Divestiture of the Wear Resistance business will complete Thermadyne's strategic refocusing around its core cutting and welding activities," said Thermadyne chief executive Gerald Curran.
